svg.title: Goods trade: From the United States
svg.desc: Three separate geographies, not a regional total. Missing observations and definition changes are not connected.

g.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
g.text: Sources: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis; UN Comtrade (U.S. reporter). Macau dashed: customs exports
FOB/imports CIF; others: BEA balance-of-payments. Accounting differs. Missing years and definition changes
stay unconnected. Log scale: zeros are omitted, never replaced.
